bind-first-then-prepare.title: Prevent Browser Daemon Startup Race Corruption

the-suffix-list-and-the-table-that-check.title: Test Browser Egress Hostname Deny Lists

every-test-was-green-and-it-had-never-wo.title: Test Chromium Proxy Isolation with Real Probes
every-test-was-green-and-it-had-never-wo.description: Run native egress preflight through the real browser driver and verify that forbidden destinations actually reach the denying gateway.

the-check-and-the-browser-read-different.title: Fix URL Parser Discrepancies in SSRF Checks

the-gateway-held-but-the-answer-leaked.title: Audit HTTP Proxy Response Smuggling Risks

one-daemon-many-conversations.title: Concurrent Requests in a Python Browser Daemon
one-daemon-many-conversations.description: Remove daemon-wide request serialization so a long browser task does not block independent sessions; preserve ordering within each session.

127-0-0-1-did-not-look-like-an-ip-addres.title: Block Alternate IP Encodings in Browser SSRF

a-session-id-is-not-browser-authority.title: Authorize Remote Browser Sessions Across Reconnects
a-session-id-is-not-browser-authority.description: Bind browser operations to the authenticated owner and lifecycle so a session identifier alone cannot grant access after reconnect.

a-thread-is-not-an-async-runtime.title: Migrate Browser Automation to an Async Runtime
a-thread-is-not-an-async-runtime.description: Replace a shared blocking worker with owned async execution so separate browser sessions can make progress concurrently.

focus-before-delete.title: Verify Browser Input Focus Before Replacing Text
focus-before-delete.description: Check that focus reached the intended editor before select-all and delete, preventing successful commands from clearing the wrong content.

input-was-the-uncancellable-part.title: Cancel Async Browser Manual Login Prompts
input-was-the-uncancellable-part.description: Move cancellation to the terminal-input boundary so stopping wait_for_manual_login does not leave a worker waiting for input.

sleep-was-the-global-lock.title: Prevent time.sleep from Blocking Browser Tabs
sleep-was-the-global-lock.description: Make humanized typing and pointer timing awaitable so one tab's simulated input does not freeze another tab.

the-browser-opened-before-we-knew-it-was.title: Verify Chromium Egress Isolation Before Navigation
the-browser-opened-before-we-knew-it-was.description: Require a browser preflight after launch to prove proxy refusal and network isolation before declaring a private browser ready.

sync-on-the-outside-async-on-the-inside.title: Wrap a Python Async Runtime in a Synchronous API
sync-on-the-outside-async-on-the-inside.description: Keep synchronous Browser methods over one owned event loop, with explicit thread ownership and shutdown joining.

one-browser-api-three-engine-promises.title: Validate Browser Engine Selection in Daemon Reuse
one-browser-api-three-engine-promises.description: Check the running daemon's engine before sending commands so a paid Onion browser request cannot silently use another engine.

the-matcher-left-the-loop.title: Keep Browser DOM Matching from Blocking asyncio
the-matcher-left-the-loop.description: Move synchronous model-backed element matching off the browser event loop so unrelated tabs respond while a model is pending.

the-paid-launcher-was-on-the-wrong-loop.title: Fix Sync and Async Browser Launcher Integration
the-paid-launcher-was-on-the-wrong-loop.description: Expose an async Onionwright paid launcher for the Patchright event loop while preserving charge, renewal, expiry, and release ownership.

the-proxy-replied-but-the-429-disappeare.title: Prevent TCP Resets from Hiding HTTP 429 Responses
the-proxy-replied-but-the-429-disappeare.description: A proxy that closes with unread peer bytes can reset the socket on macOS; test that the client receives the overload response before closure.

the-second-tab-was-not-concurrent.title: Measure Concurrency Across Browser Tabs
the-second-tab-was-not-concurrent.description: Time simultaneous operations to distinguish tab isolation from concurrency, then move daemon and driver work onto one async runtime.

the-upload-button-was-in-another-documen.title: Handle iframe Uploads in Async Browser Automation
the-upload-button-was-in-another-documen.description: Preserve frame routing and listener timing during async migration so file inputs in another document remain reachable.

the-url-passed-but-the-socket-was-still-.title: Enforce Browser SSRF Policy at the Egress Socket
the-url-passed-but-the-socket-was-still-.description: Resolve, validate, and dial approved numeric addresses in the gateway; a URL check before page.goto cannot control later connections.

a-stable-candidate-cannot-ignore-late-ev.title: Retest Release Candidates After Late Bug Reports
a-stable-candidate-cannot-ignore-late-ev.description: Stop stable promotion when unattended browser acceptance reveals a new failure; publish new immutable candidate bytes and repeat the gate.

one-fix-every-newer-line.title: Verify Stable Fixes Across Active Release Branches
one-fix-every-newer-line.description: Audit Git ancestry and track each forward-port obligation before promoting a higher release line that lacks a stable maintenance fix.

a-durable-downgrade-must-also-be-live.title: Live AI Agent Permission Downgrades
a-durable-downgrade-must-also-be-live.description: Publish the narrowed provider lifecycle revision when Host permissions change so open Work Rooms immediately reflect stored authority.

a-new-candidate-needs-a-new-name.title: Version Immutable Python Release Candidates

a-permission-change-has-one-public-truth.title: Publish Atomic Agent Permission Changes
a-permission-change-has-one-public-truth.description: Emit the final permission state after a downgrade so stopping and reopening native provider work cannot expose an intermediate authority.

a-permission-is-a-complete-state.title: Reconcile Host and Provider Permission State
a-permission-is-a-complete-state.description: Test acknowledged outer-mode downgrades after real provider Stop and parent follow-up, including remaining Full Access turn budgets.

a-tool-result-is-not-a-final-answer.title: Recover Agent Turns After Empty Model Responses
a-tool-result-is-not-a-final-answer.description: Distinguish a successful Claude Code tool result from parent-turn completion so an empty model answer cannot strand the chat composer.

arm-the-deadline-before-the-tool-returns.title: Prevent Parent Agent Hangs with a 90-Second Deadline
arm-the-deadline-before-the-tool-returns.description: Arm the parent model's 90-second settlement limit before provider work starts and recover the boundary from durable codex or claude_code traces.

auto-must-mean-the-same-promise.title: Map Auto Permissions Across Codex and Claude Code
auto-must-mean-the-same-promise.description: Translate Host Auto intent into each native provider's workspace controls while preserving the separately confirmed Full Access ceiling.

one-approval-boundary-is-enough.title: Avoid Duplicate Approvals in Native Agent Delegation
one-approval-boundary-is-enough.description: Define one explicit handoff from Host policy to native provider approval so a managed delegation does not stall behind nested dialogs.

the-daemon-was-not-the-slow-part.title: Reduce Browser CLI Startup Import Latency
the-daemon-was-not-the-slow-part.description: Measure the command path before blaming the daemon queue; avoid importing the entire persistent service for every state query.

the-first-correct-snapshot-was-still-wro.title: Prevent Stale Full Access in Work Room Snapshots
the-first-correct-snapshot-was-still-wro.description: Publish one provider snapshot at the final authority ceiling after Stop and downgrade, then verify reopened native sessions.

the-last-change-is-the-name.title: Promote Python Release Candidates to Stable
the-last-change-is-the-name.description: Change package version and Production/Stable metadata together, run twine check, and switch docs only after PyPI serves the final package.

the-snapshot-that-arrived-thirty-nine-ti.title: Deduplicate Work Room Snapshot Events
the-snapshot-that-arrived-thirty-nine-ti.description: Separate replacement snapshots from append-only events so repeated provider state cannot flood the chat and hide an approval.

the-tool-finished-but-the-turn-did-not.title: Fix Agent Hangs After Native Tool Execution
the-tool-finished-but-the-turn-did-not.description: Bound parent model settlement, retry once after a timeout, and end with an explicit error if the retry also expires.

the-workspace-default-was-already-known.title: Configure Safe Default Workspaces for AI Agents
the-workspace-default-was-already-known.description: Use the Host-owned workspace when a native coding call omits a directory, while rejecting requests outside the authorized boundary.

a-release-candidate-is-a-testable-artifa.title: Verify Python Release Candidate Artifacts
a-release-candidate-is-a-testable-artifa.description: Test a clean public wheel through real browser and provider journeys, and keep its bytes unchanged during release acceptance.

the-work-room-needed-its-own-permissions.title: Expose Native Provider Permissions in Work Rooms

a-snapshot-is-not-live-state.title: Drive Agent Dashboards from Lifecycle Events

a-transcript-is-not-a-client.title: Add Follow-Up Input to Claude Code Work Rooms

a-workspace-boundary-is-not-a-path.title: Redact Host Paths from Agent Boundary Errors
a-workspace-boundary-is-not-a-path.description: Reject out-of-workspace provider requests without exposing private roots, missing paths, file names, or symlink targets in public errors.

an-action-is-not-a-reason.title: Write Accurate Agent Tool Activity Labels
an-action-is-not-a-reason.description: Describe the operation being performed above a tool call and leave supporting evidence available without inventing model rationale.

an-invite-is-not-an-environment.title: Invocation-Scoped Credentials for AI Agent Onboarding
an-invite-is-not-an-environment.description: Pass co ai --invite-code for a local run or --invite-code-file for automation while keeping temporary credentials out of persistent configuration.

the-approval-belonged-to-the-wrong-room.title: Route Codex Follow-Up Approvals to the Provider
the-approval-belonged-to-the-wrong-room.description: Place native session decisions in the Work Room that can answer them so Host-level approval does not silently stall provider follow-ups.

the-beta-caught-the-wrong-question.title: Use Action Labels for AI Tool Call Visibility
the-beta-caught-the-wrong-question.description: Change tool summaries from inferred reasons to observable actions so type-correct UI contracts do not encourage invented explanations.

the-bill-and-the-counter-disagreed.title: Reconcile Cached LLM Tokens with Billing
the-bill-and-the-counter-disagreed.description: Use one source of truth for new, cached, and output-token accounting so the chat can explain the charge on a managed request.

the-timeout-that-blocked-recovery.title: Recover Browser Commands After Navigation Timeouts

the-workroom-lost-the-conversation.title: Render Claude Code Conversations in Work Rooms

a-mode-is-not-a-compatibility-shim.title: Strict AI Agent Permission Modes and Compatibility

a-url-is-one-piece-of-data.title: Keep OAuth Login URLs Copyable in Terminals

the-log-sent-us-to-the-wrong-file.title: Report Credential Provenance in Deployment Logs

an-iteration-limit-is-not-success.title: Return Failure When Agent Iterations Run Out

three-labels-were-one-decision.title: Manage AI Agent Permission Modes Across Providers
three-labels-were-one-decision.description: Map Host Auto, Read only, and Full Access to native provider settings so legacy Default and workspace labels cannot imply different authority.

a-server-quota-is-not-a-ceiling.title: Select Server Regions with co server new

authorise-in-advance-so-nobody-signs-at-.title: Authorize Reverse Proxy Egress Before Agent Runs

new-feature-work-needs-a-new-number.title: Separate Feature Releases from Stabilization

the-browser-gate-was-only-windows.title: Test Installed Browser CLI on macOS and Windows

the-model-was-holding-the-browser.title: Prevent Slow LLM Calls from Blocking Browser Sessions

a-stop-request-is-not-a-stop.title: Confirm Native Codex Stop with Lifecycle Events

a-thumbnail-is-evidence-not-a-placeholde.title: Validate Work Room Image Artifact Thumbnails

a-workroom-has-one-writer.title: Single-Writer Architecture for AI Agent State

auto-is-a-boundary-not-a-bypass.title: Define Workspace-Bounded Auto Mode for Agents

a-session-id-is-not-a-work-room.title: Expose Claude Code Session Lifecycle to Clients

a-user-message-is-not-always-a-string.description: Extract text from structured user content without discarding image parts or calling string methods on a list.

the-long-tail-of-a-default.title: Update Model Defaults Across Code and Documentation

the-screenshot-was-not-the-test.title: Verify Agent UI State Against Protocol and Resources
the-screenshot-was-not-the-test.description: Test screenshots alongside provider state, reconnect behavior, and operating-system resources to prove Stop and resume actually work.

the-second-connection-was-still-the-firs.title: Make WebSocket Agent Reconnect Authentication Idempotent

labels-need-a-release-home.title: Triage GitHub Issues with Labels and Release Targets

every-pr-tells-its-story.title: Require Feature Documentation in Pull Requests

one-default-five-answers.title: Centralize the Default LLM Model Configuration

the-cache-was-invisible.title: Expose LLM Prompt Cache Usage and Costs

the-cli-is-the-product.description: Expose API features in CLI help and route email ownership failures to co email addresses so users can find a valid next command.

the-third-argument-was-already-taken.title: Add Outlook Reply Attachments Without Breaking Calls

when-logging-looked-like-authoring.title: Allow Shell Log Appends Under Agent Write Policy

an-image-prefix-is-not-an-image.title: Reject Truncated Base64 Image Uploads
an-image-prefix-is-not-an-image.description: Validate complete data URLs and image payloads before upload so base64-looking text cannot enter the image path.

a-patch-must-move-forward.title: Track Forward-Ports for Stable Release Fixes
a-patch-must-move-forward.description: Require a forward-port issue for each stable fix and resolve its applicability to every active newer release before publication.

connectonion-1-6-12.title: ConnectOnion 1.6.12: Regions and Shared Mailboxes
connectonion-1-6-12.description: Release notes for server-region choice, shared mailboxes, collision-safe Outlook downloads, and bounded provider requests.

workroom-is-a-view.title: Remote Clients for Native Codex and Claude Code

an-approval-is-not-execution-time.title: Pause Codex Timeouts During Manual Approval

a-tool-transaction-is-not-a-work-room.title: Stream Native Coding Activity and Approvals
a-tool-transaction-is-not-a-work-room.description: Send live provider activity and approval events through OIP while keeping raw terminal detail out of the default chat surface.

gemini-37-default.title: Roll Out a New Default Gemini Model Safely
gemini-37-default.description: Verify backend support before clients request the new default, and preserve explicit user model choices.

deployed-agent-identity.title: Separate Agent Identity from Operator Billing

oip-native-coding-adapters.title: Integrate Codex and Claude Code Through OIP
oip-native-coding-adapters.description: Use one browser-facing protocol while native backend adapters retain provider sessions, approval behavior, and execution ownership.

connectonion-1-6.title: ConnectOnion 1.6.0 Remote Agent Security Release
connectonion-1-6.description: Review the release's remote-agent controls and the separation of deployed agent credentials from operator identity.

trust-keyword.title: Design Bidirectional Agent Authorization with Trust
